input.source: immutable eight preauthored synthetic 32×24-pixel tiles for CAL-VS200-GRID-001 revision 1; no upload
input.scale: 0.5 mm per synthetic pixel, +X along slide, +Z across it; stage outer-corner convention. Indexed pixel center = tile origin + (index+0.5)×pixel spacing
input.interaction: current tile plus indexed pixel (X 0–31, Z 0–23)

output.fields: slide ID/revision, stage origins in mm, merged 116×44 intensity grid, overlap match metrics, fiducial centroids and source SHA-256; separate fiducial CSV, mosaic PNG preview

failure: Wrong source fingerprint, unsupported geometry, tile-offset residual or disagreement in overlap rejects the comparison entirely.
limits: Read-only fixed mosaic. No real acquisition, focus model, pyramid, optical resolution, illumination, automation, data measured by Evident, biological tissue or processing workflow.
downstream: No verified importer of the complete mosaic schema.
